effectSummary.ko: 마력 회수를 1.5초 이상 중단 없이 유지하고 자신의 균열 결계 안에 있으면 최대 HP 10% 보호막을 4초간 얻습니다. 재발동 간격은 6초입니다. 충전 재시작으로 이 간격을 초기화하지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: After channeling Mana Reclaim uninterrupted for at least 1.5s inside your own Rift Ward, gain a 10% maximum-health shield for 4s. Internal cooldown: 6s; restarting the channel does not reset it.

description.ko: 제자리에서 마력을 집중해 기본 마나 회복 속도의 10배로 회복한다. 이동하거나 공격하면 자동으로 종료되며, 피격만으로는 종료되지 않는다. 쿨타임이 없다.
description.en: Stand still and channel mana at ten times the base regeneration rate. Moving or attacking cancels the channel; taking damage alone does not. No cooldown.

description.ko: 현재 위치에 반경 3m의 결계를 6초간 만들고 최대 HP 10% 보호막을 4초간 얻습니다. 결계 안에 있는 동안 받는 피해가 10% 감소합니다. 최대 1개이며 M05 시전으로 처리하지 않습니다.
description.en: Create a 3m ward at the current position for 6s and a 10% maximum-HP barrier for 4s. Take 10% less damage while inside. Limit 1; it does not count as casting M05.

concept: A broad dark violet mage sash belt with a serene narrow rift-shaped gap inside its large silver buckle, paired smooth blue crystal halves held by a continuous protective oval brace. Quiet solid material contrast, no portal or energy mist.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LM44, Quiet Rift, class Mage, slot belt.
Subject design: A broad dark violet mage sash belt with a serene narrow rift-shaped gap inside its large silver buckle, paired smooth blue crystal halves held by a continuous protective oval brace. Quiet solid material contrast, no portal or energy mist.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: After channeling Mana Reclaim uninterrupted for at least 1.5s inside your own Rift Ward, gain a 10% maximum-health shield for 4s. Internal cooldown: 6s; restarting the channel does not reset it.
Direct skill context: M13 Mana Reclaim — Stand still and channel mana at ten times the base regeneration rate. Moving or attacking cancels the channel; taking damage alone does not. No cooldown.; M14 Rift Ward — Create a 3m ward at the current position for 6s and a 10% maximum-HP barrier for 4s. Take 10% less damage while inside. Limit 1; it does not count as casting M05.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: 1024 by 1024 pixel square PNG requested, with genuinely native transparent alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Scale the equipment down within the square: the full object should occupy only the CENTRAL 72% of canvas width and height. Keep at least 14% completely empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides, including above crown peaks and around both weapon tips. Do not zoom in or maximize its size. Complete object, no clipping, no missing tips. This visible empty margin is essential. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
